name: Natural Disasters
overview: Scripture reveals that natural disasters such as earthquakes and famines are part of the fallen world's realities and signs of the times, as Jesus described in Matthew 24:7 and Mark 13:7. Isaiah 45:7 affirms that the LORD sovereignly governs both light and darkness, peace and calamity, showing His control even over these events. In times of distress caused by such upheavals, the believer is called to cry out to God, who hears and responds, as expressed in Psalms 18:6. Furthermore, God promises restoration and comfort to the afflicted, assuring that He will rebuild and establish firm foundations after the storm, as seen in Isaiah 54:11.
